subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a variable cost for a firm ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Property taxes.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Variable costs **are expenses that** vary** with the level of production or sales.

 
 
• They increase as production or sales** increase and decrease** as production or sales decrease.
 
 
 
• In contrast, **fixed costs** are expenses that** do not vary** with production or sales levels.
 
• **Commissions and labor costs** are both examples of** variable costs.**
 
 
• Commissions are paid based on the **level of sales**, so they increase when sales increase and decrease when sales decrease.
 
• Labor costs similarly **increase **as production increases and **decrease **as production decreases.
 
 
 
• **Packing costs** could be either a** variable or fixed cost** depending on how they are structured.
 
 
• If the cost of packing materials and labor varies with the level of production, then it is a** variable cost**.
 
• If it is a** fixed cost** that does not vary with production levels, then it is a fixed cost.
 
 
 
• **Property taxes**, on the other hand, are typically a **fixed cost**.
 
 
• They are based on the assessed value of the property and** do not vary** with production or sales levels.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commissions** are **payments** made to salespeople or other employees based on their level of sales or performance.

 
 
• They are a form of** incentive compensation** that is designed to** motivate employees **to work harder and sell more.
 
 
 
• **Property taxes** are taxes that are levied on **real estate property**.
 
 
• They are typically assessed by local governments and are based on the** value** of the property.
 
• They are used to fund a variety of** local services**, such as schools, police, and fire departments.
 
 
 
• **Labor costs **are the wages and benefits paid to employees.
 
 
• They are a **major expense** for many companies and can vary widely depending on the type of work being done and the location of the company.
 
 
 
• **Packing costs** are the expenses associated with packaging and shipping products.
 
 
• They can include the **cost of materials, labor, and shipping fees.**
